findings.requirement: Search matches partial queries across every user-visible work-item field.
findings.behavior: Search now checks only whether the combined name/summary/tags string starts with the query; owner and note are omitted entirely.
findings.impact: Users cannot find matching work items by owner or note, or by a partial term occurring after the beginning of the item name.
findings.reproduction: Given {name:"Roadmap", owner:"Alice", summary:"Quarterly plan", note:"Customer waiting", tags:[]}, query "map", "Alice", or "Customer" returns no match even though each query partially matches a user-visible field.
findings.recommendation: Restore all user-visible fields and use substring matching, e.g. [item.name, item.owner, item.summary, item.note, ...item.tags].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(filters.query.trim().toLowerCase()). Add regression tests for partial matches in every field; they should fail before and pass after the fix.

findings.requirement: A specific status selection includes only that workflow status.
findings.behavior: Every specific status selection applies the same condition: include every non-Blocked item. Selecting Blocked returns no blocked items, while selecting another status includes unrelated statuses.
findings.impact: Status-filtered queues are incorrect and can omit the requested work or mix it with unrelated work.
findings.reproduction: With one Open, one Escalated, and one Blocked item, selecting Escalated returns both Open and Escalated; selecting Blocked returns Open and Escalated but not Blocked. The All selection still returns all three.
findings.recommendation: Restore item.status === filters.status for non-All selections. Add a truth-table test covering All and every workflow status, asserting that each specific choice returns only exact matches.

findings.requirement: Risk scoring preserves due-today urgency and blocked-item weighting.
findings.behavior: Due-today and due-in-one-or-two-days items now receive the same 12-point urgency, replacing the distinct 24-point due-today weight; the accompanying status calculation also removes all Blocked-item weighting.
findings.impact: Immediately due and blocked work is systematically under-ranked, so the queue and critical metrics can fail to surface the most urgent operational risks.
findings.reproduction: Two otherwise identical items due in 0 and 2 days now receive identical urgency scores of 12, whereas due-today previously received 24. Two otherwise identical Blocked and ordinary non-Escalated items now both receive a zero status penalty, whereas Blocked previously received 18 and the ordinary item 6.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the dueInDays === 0 urgency branch and explicit Blocked weighting while making any intended broader scoring changes. Add regression tests proving due-today retains its higher urgency and Blocked retains its required weight; those tests should fail before and pass after the fix.

findings.requirement: Summary metrics count both blocked and escalated work.
findings.behavior: The summary's blocked metric counts only Escalated items and excludes items whose status is Blocked.
findings.impact: Portfolio summaries underreport work requiring intervention and can show zero despite blocked work being present.
findings.reproduction: For a portfolio containing one Blocked item and one Escalated item, summarizePortfolio returns blocked: 1 instead of 2; with only the Blocked item, it returns blocked: 0.
findings.recommendation: Count item.status === "Blocked" || item.status === "Escalated". Add regression coverage for Blocked-only, Escalated-only, and mixed portfolios.

findings.requirement: The queue shows every matching item unless pagination is explicitly introduced.
findings.behavior: The queue silently renders only the first five supplied items, with no pagination or other way to reach later matches.
findings.impact: Any sixth or later matching work item disappears from the primary queue and cannot be selected there, blocking users from acting on valid results.
findings.reproduction: Pass six matching items to WorkQueue. Only items at indexes 0 through 4 produce buttons; the item at index 5 is absent and no pagination control is rendered.
findings.recommendation: Render all items, or introduce explicit pagination with navigation and accessible item-count semantics. Add a regression test supplying at least six matching items and asserting every item is reachable; it should fail before and pass after the fix.
